attributes.name: Braque du Bourbonnais
attributes.description: The Braque du Bourbonnais is a medium-sized breed of hunting dog from the Bourbonnais region of France. These dogs are medium in size, with a short and wiry coat of fur. They have a friendly and energetic demeanor, with an instinct for hunting. They are highly intelligent and trainable, but require firm and consistent training to be obedient. They are loyal and devoted to their family, but can be stubborn and independent at times.
